mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perms FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND (r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id OR r.tenant_id IS NULL) AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND rp.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND p.perms IS NOT NULL AND p.perms != ''

SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id AND ur.tenant_id = rp.tenant_id AND ur.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND (r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id OR r.tenant_id IS NULL) AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 WHERE rp.permission_id = #{permissionId} AND rp.deleted = 0
